HONU, learning methods, and GUI parameters
===========================================

This section documents the higher-order neural units (HONU), their learning
methods, the MLP prediction backend used by MPC, and the common parameters
exposed in the **HONU MRAC** and **HONU MPC** pages. Python identifiers are
written exactly as used by the project.
